title: Spaced repetition basics
description: Core ideas behind spacing, retrieval, and short study sessions.

cards.back: Reviewing material at expanding intervals so you retrieve it just as you would start to forget.

cards.front: Why is retrieval practice better than re-reading?
cards.back: Retrieving strengthens the memory trace; re-reading mostly trains recognition and feels easier than it is.
Recall drops quickly after learning unless you review; each successful review slows the next drop.
Short sessions are easier to repeat daily; consistency beats rare marathon cramming.

cards.front: What should one flashcard usually contain?
cards.back: One clear idea — a single prompt and a short, checkable answer.
